userPrompt: Draft a polite reminder email about an overdue invoice.
responseText:
**Subject:** Gentle Reminder: Overdue Invoice [Invoice Number]

Dear [Client's Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

This is a polite reminder that Invoice #[Invoice Number], issued on [Issue Date] for $[Amount Due], is now past due. Payment was due on [Due Date].

Could you please let me know when we might expect settlement? I’d be grateful if you could arrange payment at your earliest convenience.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. Please don’t hesitate to contact me if you have any questions or need a copy of the invoice.

Warm regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Your Contact Information]
